Ongoing Russian attacks make protecting Ukraine's skies an urgent priority, according to a statement by Ukrainian Acting Foreign Minister [Andrii Sybiha](https://x.com/andrii_sybiha/status/2088972552345440316).

## **Strengthening air defenses, Black Sea security**

During talks with his Greek counterpart, George Gerapetritis, Ukraine's foreign minister spoke about the consequences of Russia's relentless strikes on Ukrainian cities, as well as critical infrastructure and ports.

Sybiha stressed that the growing scale of Russia's missile and drone terror **requires urgent action to protect Ukrainian skies**. The security of maritime routes was another key topic of the talks.
